Theorem
[Hamilton's 4-Manifold Theorem] ↗ prop:curvature-operator ↗ prob:curvature-operator 1. ch12:12.38

If $M$ is a simply connected compact Riemannian $4$-manifold with positive curvature operator, then $M$ is diffeomorphic to $S^4$.

This is Hamilton's theorem [Ham86].

The all-dimensional extension is due to Böhm and Wilking \cite{BW08}.
